node.title: Affine-core cogirth ray bound
node.statement: Let A be an affine subspace over a nonconstant syndrome line, let K=(A-A) intersect ker H have dimension a, and assume genericity at radius r. The coordinate matroid of K restricted to any error zero set has cogirth at least Delta-r and hence at least C(Delta-r+a-1,a) bases. Charging nonpersistent zeros gives |P|C(Delta-r+a-1,a)<=C(N,a)(N-a). Exact XR arithmetic pays full-domain selector ranks 4,4,3,11,11,10; combined with the collision-line self-localized charts it closes the complete high-core rank-four branch on all six rows. || w8-C8 CORRECTION (2026-07-16, forced): the 'closes the complete high-core rank-four branch on all six rows' sentence above PRE-DATES catch #158 and contradicted the P-A statement's scoped form; correct scoping = five rows unconditional + RowC 1/16 line-covered/line-admitting hulls -- and the remaining #158 sub-case is now ALSO discharged covering-free by xr_affine_core_all_zero_charge (wave-8, AZC margin 0.5005%, pin note w8-C9).
